info.title: polaris API
info.description:
The api behind the polaris back-office webapp. Generated from the backend route definitions by tools/openapi.ts -- do not edit by hand.

Every request needs `Authorization: Bearer <UI_SECRET>`, one password shared by both environments. Served from the same hostname as the webapp, as a second origin on one CloudFront distribution, so there is no cross-origin request to configure.

get.description: Each environment reports its own instance. Available in production too, where it is read-only.

200.description: The state of the instance after the call

status.description: The instance's RDS status verbatim: available, stopped, starting, stopping, backing-up, modifying, ... or `unknown` if RDS reported none

canStart.description: Whether POST /api/db/start would be accepted right now

canStop.description: Whether POST /api/db/stop would be accepted right now

readOnly.description: True outside the test environment, where the instance can only be reported. Lets the ui say why the buttons are dead instead of leaving it indistinguishable from a transition

status.description: Repeats the http status, for logging

name.description: The error class, e.g. ForbiddenError or InternalServerError

message.description: Safe to show a viewer. Always `Internal Server Error` on a 500 -- an unexpected error's own message is logged and dropped

code.description: A stable identifier to branch on, e.g. FORBIDDEN

post.description: Test environment only; 403 elsewhere. A no-op unless the status is exactly `stopped` -- RDS rejects a start during any transition.
